scope: simulation-only finite-grid study; one independent training split
timing_pilot: Two 256-period windows, rho=1 and 1.6, completed in 0.06 s; no phase or ML outcome used for selection.

tail.question: Conditional finite-support tail compatibility, not an unbounded power-law claim

stress.unit_of_analysis: same held-out base window; rescaled copies stay exclusively in test

statistics.primary_difference: absolute error joint minus return-only, negative favors joint
statistics.test: centered stratified paired-bootstrap approximation for the mean loss difference; conditional on fitted models
statistics.multiplicity: Holm over the three within-estimator view contrasts; tail GOF is a separate family of three
